{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that exceeds 0.3-0.5 points per day",
    "Lag effect: model fails to fully capture price momentum, especially during upward moves where it lags behind by 1-2 days",
    "Sentiment alignment: high sentiment (value ≥ 0.67) fails to lift model forecasts enough, showing sentiment-missing in bullish periods",
    "Mean-reversion overshoot: when prices deviate from history mean, model goes further than prices actually revert",
    "Volatility mismatch: model under-forecasts price swings in examples 4-5 where true outcomes show more variation than forecasts",
    "Sentiment weakness: high sentiment readings (1.00) in history don't translate to proportionally higher forecasts, showing sentiment weight is too low"
] }
